properties.name: Cú Chulainn
properties.description: Greatest hero of the Ulster Cycle. Son of the god Lugh. His battle frenzy (ríastrad) transformed him into a terrifying creature. Died standing, tied to a pillar.

properties.name: The Dagda
properties.description: Good god of the Tuatha Dé Danann. Wielded a club that could kill and resurrect, a cauldron of plenty, and a harp that controlled seasons and emotions.

properties.name: Lugh
properties.description: Master of all arts and skills. Father of Cú Chulainn. Led the Tuatha Dé Danann to victory. Lughnasadh harvest festival named after him.

properties.name: Brigid
properties.description: Triple goddess of fire, poetry, and healing. So beloved she was absorbed into Christianity as St. Brigid. Imbolc (February 1st) is her festival.
